```{python}
# Establish connection
conn = psycopg2.connect("host=inaturalist-dev.cu9mqs2m0f9r.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com dbname=postgres user=postgres, password=aws-cc2200")
cur = conn.cursor()
# Insert data into PostgreSQL
for index, row in df.iterrows():
    cur.execute(
        "INSERT INTO raw_stg.food_access VALUES ( %s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s)",
        tuple(row)  # Convert row to tuple for SQL execution
    )

# Commit the transaction
conn.commit()
```
